editorialReview.scope: Independent editorial review of 16 HK, three HKE and three HKP cards; no own world cards re-reviewed.
editorialReview.status: Complete: no demonstrated source-ban violation or unresolved factual blocker; sourcing limitations retained.

findings.finding: Single government statement dominates factual sourcing, without merchant response. Article has HK01 reporter attribution and no government press-release/full-reprint label. No verbatim-copy comparison was performed; this is an editorial sourcing limitation, NOT a demonstrated violation of the written source ban.
findings.evidence: hk-article-hkl-2.txt opens 食環署食安中心今日（9日）表示 and all factual product/recall details attributed to centre.

findings.finding: All outbreak facts attributed to CHP, no care-home or relative response. The article is attributed to Cable News and has no government release/full-reprint label. No direct verbatim-copy evidence; source restriction violation cannot be established from government-topic content alone.
findings.evidence: hk-article-hks-7.txt three short paragraphs, all outbreak findings and future screening from CHP.

findings.finding: Valuation headline should state USD; 2.5 billion without currency ambiguous. Review says company did not respond, article actually says declined to comment.
findings.evidence: root-chip.txt: roughly $2.5 billion valuation; funding not closed; Nuvacore declined to comment.
findings.resolution: Re-read root.json: headline now explicitly 25億美元. Parent confirmed declined-comment correction in review.

verified: hks 8 has four publishers, hkl 8 has three publishers, hke 3 has two publishers, hkp 3 has two publishers (ST editorial and Dimsum Daily).
All 16 HK and three HKE first-publication metadata after Oct9 21:00 and before current local clock. No card URL repeats yesterday PM exclusions.
Lions Rock first paragraph identifies friend ill, later fuller paragraph explicitly states 17-year-old also felt unwell and was rescued; headline is supported by body, not description alone.
Yuen Long 87-year-old recovered consciousness explicitly in body; no invented death or continuing coma.
Oil Ma Tei 46-year-old and Lam Tin 57-year-old are separate addresses, ages and discoveries; cause awaits autopsy.
Tuen Mun driver dashboard footage and personal account is new evidence after yesterday traffic-delay story. Current card does not adopt driver's account as established responsibility.
Tang gallery story includes artists allegations and Vivian Har denial, unpaid liability remains disputed; Thai lawyer says suit filed despite gallery denial.
CUHK loneliness research surveyed 1462 last June-November; 40.4% is students, 34% young adults; card does not substitute all youth denominator.
CUHK science fair includes own reporter event photographs, university startup participation; card omits government speech and GDP promises.
Science citation card specifies own disciplines and 469 CUHK scholars; not university overall rank, different institutions from prior EdU/Lingnan story.
Architects Institute suggestions are a new stakeholder response after prior One Stanley warranty story; not completed reform or new proof of defective structure.
Wine and Dine article describes Oct29-Nov1 future event, advance card sales Oct7-11 and general sales Oct12; no claim event already open.
Basketball scores 115-61 and 121-73 yield 54 and 48 point margins as stated.
Wall Street close is Oct9 New York session, materially separate from yesterday PM Hong Kong close and Oct8 US close.
Nuvacore funding and valuation attributed to two sources, round not completed and could change.
Kalshi investigation attributed to WSJ quoting spokesperson; CNA/Reuters says Kalshi declined further comment; not proven insider trading.

HKP first publications Oct10 07:00:57, Oct9 23:09:34 and Oct9 22:54:41 HKT all satisfy first-publication window and precede checkedAt. DD article UTC metadata +8 consistent with producing-agent wp-json verification.

HKP voucher details at least HK$1000 for permanent residents aged 18+ and restored student allowance are stakeholder proposals. Prior PM card covered motion passing, vague KPIs, jobs and maintenance; fresh detailed proposals are distinct, not another report of the same vote. They remain unadopted proposals.

HKP bribe court appearance adds actual HK$2000 bail, no witness contact/no return to alleged scene, and December14 adjournment, beyond baseline charged-and-awaiting-Oct9-appearance. Card preserves allegation/unresolved guilt. Existing future court node now Dec14 must be retained.

meta.title: 社論：華府簽證政策一緊再緊 正中中港搶人才下懷
meta.description: 拿破崙說過：「當敵人正在犯錯，千萬不要打斷他。」這句話用在特朗普政府身上，再適合不過。它將會無限期暫停多間科技公司參與「永久勞工認證」的計劃，讓那些效力的外籍專才難以取得綠卡。這種政策所反映的，顯然是所謂「美國優先」的思維。但從口碑來看，矽谷一致反對簽證政策又一次收緊，因為此舉必定損害美國招攬英才的能力，最終讓「敵人」得益。 華府排拒更多「馬斯克們」 單論人才政策，特朗普回朝不足兩年，已是昏招迭出

ld.description: 拿破崙說過：「當敵人正在犯錯，千萬不要打斷他。」這句話用在特朗普政府身上，再適合不過。它將會無限期暫停多間科技公司參與「永久勞工認證」的計劃，讓那些效力的外籍專才難以取得綠卡。這種政策所反映的，顯然是所謂「美國優先」的思維。但從口碑來看，矽谷一致反對簽證政策又一次收緊，因為此舉必定損害美國招攬英才的能力，最終讓「敵人」得益。 華府排拒更多「馬斯克們」 單論人才政策，特朗普回朝不足兩年，已是昏招迭出
ld.url: https://www.stheadline.com/daily-editorial/3624483/社論華府簽證政策一緊再緊-正中中港搶人才下懷
ld.articleBody:
拿破崙說過：「當敵人正在犯錯，千萬不要打斷他。」這句話用在特朗普政府身上，再適合不過。它將會無限期暫停多間科技公司參與「永久勞工認證」的計劃，讓那些效力的外籍專才難以取得綠卡。這種政策所反映的，顯然是所謂「美國優先」的思維。但從口碑來看，矽谷一致反對簽證政策又一次收緊，因為此舉必定損害美國招攬英才的能力，最終讓「敵人」得益。

單論人才政策，特朗普回朝不足兩年，已是昏招迭出：從打壓哈佛、削大學科研經費，到大幅提高H-1B專業技術人員的簽證費，一錯再錯。最新一次收緊做得更為高調，因為它是由副總統萬斯親自宣布的。在記者會上，萬斯點名批評微軟，指責它在去年辭退6000名美國工人，同時取得6300個H-1B工作簽證和近3000張綠卡，直斥微軟濫用制度。
